name: Miaoyu
description: "A Dream of Red Mansions" is an epic work that shows the beauty of women and various aspects of ancient Chinese society from all angles, and has successfully created many classic characters who are well-known to every household. Pinku used "Twelve Hairpins" as its design inspiration. In the form of a fan and a hairpin, Pinku freezes the moving moments of the twelve beauties on the gorgeous round fan, outlining a picture of the Red Mansion full of humanistic sentiments. The Miaoyu Tuanfan reproduces the classic Red Mansion - Miaoyu Serving Tea with its beautiful colors and lifelike details of characters and scenery.
